title: 第2章 这碗燕窝，她先还给别人
lines: 最后，是镇北王旧伤复查时，出现短暂“心脉逆震”。
把一个名字，慢慢推到了风口浪尖。
几名太医围坐一圈，神色凝重。
每一份，都写着同一个结论：
“她的处理方式，已经超出医理。”
“你这是在夸她，还是在说她胡来？”
“我是在说——她的手法，不属于我们这一脉。”
content_zh:
相府的夜，比白日更冷。

    老太君醒来的消息，还没来得及传遍全府，就被一层无形的压力压了回去。

    正厅里灯火通明。

    却安静得像坟。

    苏晚站在中央。

    太医跪在地上，额头冷汗未干。

    相爷坐在高位，脸色阴沉。

    继母站在一侧，眼神一寸寸扫过苏晚，像在重新评估一件失控的物品。

    苏柔站在最后，手指死死掐着帕子。

    她不信。

    她不可能信。

    一个被她亲手下毒、踩进废院的“废物”，怎么可能一夜之间翻盘？

    怎么可能救活老太君？

    “说。”

    相爷终于开口。

    声音很低。

    “老太君的毒，是怎么回事？”

    太医立刻磕头。

    “回相爷，老夫人脉象紊乱，气机逆行……确实像中毒，但……”

    他不敢继续说。

    因为没有证据。

    更因为刚才那一幕。

    那三针。

    像是直接把“死”拆开，又重新拼回去。

    苏晚没看他们。

    她只是低头整理袖口。

    动作很慢。

    像根本不在意这场审问。

    继母忽然开口。

    “苏晚。”

    她声音柔得发冷。

    “你刚刚说老太君中毒。”

    “证据呢？”

    一句话，把所有人的目光都压向她。

    苏柔眼睛一亮。

    对。

    没有证据。

    只要没有证据，她就只是一个“胡言乱语的疯子”。

    苏晚终于抬眼。

    她看向继母。

    然后轻轻笑了一下。

    “证据？”

    她重复了一遍。

    “你们想要什么证据？”

    太医立刻道：

    “自然是毒源！药方！残渣！”

    苏晚点头。

    “好。”

    她转身。

    走向老太君床榻旁的小案几。

    那里放着刚刚用过的药碗。

    空的。

    但还残留着一点褐色药渍。

    所有人都看着她。

    不明白她要做什么。

    苏晚伸手。

    指尖轻轻在碗沿一抹。

    然后——

    她抬起手。

    轻轻一嗅。

    太医皱眉：

    “你这是在……”

    话没说完。

    苏晚已经开口。

    “断魂散。”

    三个字落地。

    太医脸色骤变。

    “胡说！此毒早已失传！”

    苏晚看着他。

    “是失传了。”

    “还是你们以为失传了？”

    空气瞬间一滞。

    相爷眉头紧皱。

    继母眼神一闪。

    苏柔却忍不住冷笑：

    “你随口说一个名字，就算证据？”

    苏晚转头看她。

    目光很平。
content_en:
The night in Xiangfu is colder than the day.

    The news of the old lady's awakening was suppressed by a layer of invisible pressure before it spread throughout the whole house.

    The main hall was brightly lit.

    But as quiet as a tomb.

    Su Wan stood in the center.

    The imperial doctor knelt on the ground, the cold sweat on his forehead not drying.

    The prime minister sat in a high position with a gloomy face.

    The stepmother stood to one side, her eyes scanning Su Wan inch by inch, as if she was re-evaluating an item that was out of control.

    Su Rou stood at the end, clutching the handkerchief tightly with her fingers.

    She didn't believe it.

    She couldn't believe it.

    How could a "trash" who was poisoned by her own hands and trampled into an abandoned hospital turn around overnight?

    How is it possible to save the old lady?

    "Say."

    The prime minister finally spoke.

    The voice is very low.

    "What happened to the old lady's poison?"

    The imperial doctor immediately kowtowed.

    "Replying to the Prime Minister, the old lady's pulse is disordered and her Qi is retrograde... It does seem like she was poisoned, but..."

    He didn't dare to continue.

    Because there is no evidence.

    Especially because of the scene just now.

    Those three needles.

    It's like taking "death" apart and putting it back together again.

    Su Wan didn't look at them.

    She just lowered her head to straighten her sleeves.

    The movement is slow.

    He didn't seem to care about the interrogation at all.

    The stepmother suddenly spoke.

    "Su Wan."

    Her voice was so soft that it was cold.

    "You just said that the old lady was poisoned."

    "Where's the evidence?"

    In one sentence, everyone's eyes were focused on her.

    Su Rou's eyes lit up.

    right.

    There is no evidence.

    As long as there is no evidence, she is just a "crazy maniac".

    Su Wan finally raised her eyes.

    She looked at her stepmother.

    Then he smiled softly.

    "Evidence?"

    she repeated.

    "What evidence do you want?"

    The imperial doctor immediately said:

    "Nature is the source of poison! Prescription! Residues!"

    Su Wan nodded.

    "Okay."

    She turned around.

    Go to the small desk next to the old lady's bed.

    There was a medicine bowl that had just been used.

    Empty.

    But there is still a little brown medicine stain left.

    Everyone looked at her.

    Don't understand what she is going to do.

    Su Wan stretched out her hand.

    Gently run your fingertips along the edge of the bowl.

    Then——

    She raised her hand.

    Take a gentle sniff.

    The imperial doctor frowned:

    "What are you doing..."

    The words were not finished.

    Su Wan has already spoken.

    "The soul is broken."

    Three words fell to the ground.

    The imperial doctor's expression suddenly changed.

    "Nonsense! This poison has been lost long ago!"

    Su Wan looked at him.

    "It's been lost."

    "Or do you think it was lost?"

    The air was stagnant for a moment.

    The prime minister frowned.

    The stepmother's eyes flashed.

    Su Rou could not help but sneer:

    "You just say a name and it counts as evidence?"

    Su Wan turned to look at her.

    The gaze is very level.
title_en: Chapter 2 She will return this bowl of bird’s nest to others first
